name: smart-compact
description: The agent compacts its own context between tasks, with a focus it writes for the compactor, and carries on by itself

beforeCompact.title: Before compacting
beforeCompact.description: A step the agent takes before it compacts, in lower case, e.g. "run the debrief skill"; empty for none

summaryNote.title: Note for every summary
summaryNote.description: An extra instruction the compactor gets each time, e.g. the language to write the summary in; empty for none
